source_notes.valve_position: Direct thermal power is not attenuated by a valve factor.
source_notes.room_temperature: Operative temperature on the fixed 2019 simulation calendar.
source_notes.hvac_power: Mean floor heat output over the current 15-minute interval, driving the next temperature.
source_notes.occupancy: The loader binarizes the original scheduled headcount (0 or 5).
source_notes.evaluation: Offline forecasting uses observed drivers. Online MPC requires actions and weather forecasts available at decision time.
